title: 18-electron guideline
basic_overview: The 18e guideline corresponds to filling nine valence orbitals around a transition metal.

extra_info_content.short_trick: d count + ligand donation ≈ 18e when the complex type supports the rule.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Find group/OS. 2. d count. 3. Count ligand donations. 4. Sum. 5. Check 18e and known exceptions.
extra_info_content.factors: 16e square-planar d⁸ and odd-electron/early-metal complexes can be stable.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
